# Radio group

One choice of a few shown at once.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “radio”; HTML `<fieldset><legend> with <input type="radio">`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **legend**: The question.
- **option**: A ring and its label; the label is part of the target.

## Variants

- `vertical`: Default.
- `inline`: Two or three short options.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `checked`: A dot in the ring.
- `disabled`
- `invalid`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Into the group, to the checked option. |
| Arrow keys | Move and select. |

## Accessibility

- Role: radiogroup / radio
- Name: The legend; each option its label.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<fieldset class="nd-radio">
  <legend>Preferred contact</legend>
  <label class="nd-radio__option"
    ><input
      class="nd-radio__control"
      type="radio"
      name="ex-contact"
      checked
    />
    <span>Email</span></label
  >
  <label class="nd-radio__option"
    ><input class="nd-radio__control" type="radio" name="ex-contact" />
    <span>Telegram</span></label
  >
  <label class="nd-radio__option"
    ><input
      class="nd-radio__control"
      type="radio"
      name="ex-contact"
      disabled
    />
    <span>Phone</span></label
  >
</fieldset>
```
